paywall.title: AI Training is not in your plan
paywall.body: Your plan doesn't include AI assistants. Upgrade to unlock this feature.

responder.title: Who answers your WhatsApp?
responder.body: If you turn on Meta's own Business Agent, our AI and keyword auto-replies stand down for this workspace, so your customer never gets two answers to the same message.

wadesk_only.label: Our AI answers
wadesk_only.desc: Our AI and keyword auto-replies handle chats (default).

meta_agent_only.label: Meta agent answers
meta_agent_only.desc: Meta's Business Agent replies. We only log the thread, our AI stays silent.

meta_agent_then_handoff.label: Meta agent, then handoff
meta_agent_then_handoff.desc: Meta fronts the first questions. When it escalates, the chat lands in your Team Inbox for a person. Our auto-AI stays silent.

responder.hint: Meta's agent needs a WhatsApp Business (Cloud API) number. Numbers on the unofficial engine always use our AI.
responder.readOnly: You can see this setting but not change it.
responder.saveFailed: Could not save the responder mode.
responder.loadError: Could not load the responder mode.

list.tipBody: Smart agents power your <link>chatbot widgets</link> and the AI step of your flows. The five-step builder walks you through identity, persona, brain, safety and knowledge.
list.knowledgeTipBody: One FAQ question and answer is often enough. A few help-page URLs cover most support questions, so there is no need to load your whole site.
list.title: AI
list.intro: Build smart agents that speak in your brand's voice. Train them on URLs, text, Q&A pairs and files.
list.emptyBody: Build your first agent. The five-step builder walks you through identity, persona, brain, safety and the knowledge it should have.
list.noMatch: No agent matches your search or status view.
list.deleteBody: The agent and its knowledge entries will be removed. Widgets and flows that use it will stop replying with this agent until you pick a different one.

builder.notFoundBody: This agent does not exist in your workspace, or it was deleted.
builder.saveFailed: Save failed. Check the fields and try again.
builder.conflict: This agent was changed somewhere else. Reload the page to get the latest version, then save again.

identity.title: Agent identity
identity.name: Agent display name
identity.nameHint: For your records. Visitors don't see this label.
identity.statusActive: Live: pick this agent in widgets and flows
identity.statusHint: Paused agents stay in the list but cannot be attached to new widgets.
identity.languageHint: ISO 639-1 code. Matches the visitor's language when it differs.
identity.toneHint: Sets the writing style, independent of the persona brief.

persona.title: Persona & opening line
persona.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! I'm here to help. Ask me anything about pricing or plans.
persona.greetingHint: Visitor-facing. Shown as the first bubble when the chat opens.
persona.briefPlaceholder: You are the friendly support agent for Acme Inc. Always answer in short sentences and hand over to a person for anything about refunds.
persona.briefHint: Internal, never shown to visitors. Include do's, don'ts and escalation rules.

brain.title: Model & reply controls
brain.providerHint: Your admin sets up the provider keys. Providers you added your own key for show too, on plans that allow it.
brain.modelHint: Pick one of the models enabled for you, or type another model id.
brain.noModels: No AI model is enabled for your workspace yet. Ask your admin to switch one on, or add your own key under Settings, AI keys.
brain.tokensHint: Roughly 1 token is 4 characters. 400 fits a paragraph.
brain.temperatureHint: Lower is consistent and factual. Higher gives varied phrasing.

safety.title: Fallback & human handoff
safety.fallback: Fallback reply (used when the model errors out)
safety.fallbackPlaceholder: A teammate will follow up shortly. Thanks for your patience.
safety.fallbackHint: Sent as written if the model returns nothing or the call fails.
safety.handoffHint: The visitor types the trigger phrase, the agent stops replying and your team inbox lights up.
safety.keywordHint: When a visitor types this anywhere in a message, the handoff fires.
safety.ackPlaceholder: Sure, pulling in a teammate now. Stay on the line.
safety.ackHint: The last message before the agent goes silent.

knowledge.title: Train the agent
knowledge.saveFirst: Save the agent first. Knowledge entries attach to a saved agent.

url.title: Live URL
url.body: Fetch a public page and keep its text.

text.title: Free text
text.body: Paste a help snippet or a policy.

qa.title: Q&A pair
qa.body: One question with its canonical answer.

file.title: PDF, DOCX, TXT & more
file.body: Upload a file. The text is extracted for you.

knowledge.label: Label
knowledge.question: Question

placeholder.content: Paste any text the agent should know…
placeholder.question: Question, e.g. How long do refunds take?
placeholder.answer: Answer, e.g. Refunds settle within 3 to 5 business days.

knowledge.urlHint: Only public http and https pages are read. The page is fetched in the background, so the entry shows Processing for a moment.
knowledge.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV or HTML, up to 10 MB. Text is extracted automatically.

problem.label: Add a label so you can find this entry later.
problem.question: Add the question.
problem.file: Pick a file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV or HTML).
problem.file_type: Accepted file types: TXT, Markdown, CSV, HTML, PDF, DOCX. For anything else, paste the text into a Text entry.
problem.file_legacyDoc: Legacy .doc files are not supported. Re-save as .docx (or export to .pdf) and upload again.
problem.tooLarge: That is too much text for one paste. Upload it as a file instead.

knowledge.empty: No knowledge yet. Pick a kind above to add the first entry.
knowledge.removeBody: The agent will stop using it for new replies. Older conversations stay unchanged.
